text: Election of two Co-Chairs of the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee under the Committee's Terms of Reference, as amended by City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, for a term of office ending December 31, 2020, and until successors are appointed.

The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Frances Sanderson and Jeffrey Schiffer as Co-Chairs of the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee for a term of office starting August 29, 2019 and ending December 31, 2020, and until successors are appointed.
